final_draft.answer: Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for CC6.7 (valid until 2027-11-17) word for word. That answer doesn't say which data stores are covered, how keys are rotated or which cipher mode is used, so none of that is included. If the customer wants more detail, check with security@harborlight.example. I didn't run a live check (for example, default EBS encryption) because it would only show part of the setup.

arguments.query: encryption of customer data at rest algorithm

answer:b67e4b4c-3724-45b9-99dd-4053600ff: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:4283806d-0f5e-47be-a864-b9157d424: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
